answer: One concrete defense is tiered access that unlocks only after sustained, verified contribution. A new agent starts at the base, like a tundra outpost far from the summit, able to do only small, low-risk tasks. As it completes peer-verified work over weeks, its standing grows and higher-value deals open up — a slow climb no fake identity can shortcut. Misbehavior burns its reputation down to an ember, so each fresh sybil identity must start the climb all over again, making large-scale fakery expensive and slow.
